speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: At least he's off the train crap.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Sheldon, I owe you an apology. Taking the train was a stroke of brilliance! I've actually got a shot at a Terminator.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Oh, please.When it comes to Terminators, you've got a better shot of scoring with Arnold Schwarzenegger.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You're overlooking something. I have 11 hours with her in a confined space. Unless she's willing to jump off a moving train, tuck and roll down the side of a hill, she will eventually succumb to the acquired taste that is Howard Wolowitz.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: My money's on tuck and roll.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm confused. I thought you were involved in some sort of socially intimate pairing with Leslie Winkle.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Sheldon, let me explain to you how this works. That's Summer Glau. That's it.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Hang on a sec. Why do you get first crack at her?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Um, well, let's see, couple reasons. One, I saw her first.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Fair enough. But then let me move on to number two, unlike you, I can actually talk to women when I'm sober.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You fail to take into account that even mute, I am foreign and exotic, while you, on the other hand, are frail and pasty.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Well, you know the old saying, pasty and frail never fail.
